title: Everyday Phrases — Requesting a Room Change
scene_zh: 換酒店房間 · 情境對話
title_quote: Hi there, do you have a minute?
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🏨 實用換酒店房間必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Requesting a Room Change
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用換酒店房間情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多旅行場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Requesting a Room Change phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life travel scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi there, do you have a minute?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ðɛr du ju hæv ə ˈmɪnɪt./
dialogue.zh: 嗨，您有一分鐘聽我說嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Always, what can I do for you?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlˌweɪz wʌt kæn aɪ du fər juː?/
dialogue.zh: 當然可以，您需要我做些什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, I need a favor this morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl aɪ nid ə ˈfeɪvər ðɪs ˈmɔːrnɪŋ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, is everything okay?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Something is wrong with my room.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no, which room is it?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is room 502 on the fifth floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz rum faɪv oʊ tuː ɑːn ðə faɪfθ flɔːr./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, and what is the problem?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The air conditioner is very loud.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How loud is it at night?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It makes a big noise all night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt meɪks ə bɪɡ nɔɪz ɔːl naɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That sounds hard to sleep through.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Last night I slept almost nothing.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am sorry to hear that.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My head hurts this morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bad nights always bring headaches.
dialogue.zh: 沒睡好的隔天總會頭痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So now I feel tired all day.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ naʊ aɪ fil ˈtaɪərd ɔːl deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 所以這一整天我都睏得受不了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is truly our fault.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is also a strange smell.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A smell, maybe like smoke?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, it smells like old water.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, that is not normal.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The smell gets worse at night.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: When did you first notice it?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It was there when I walked in.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wɑːz ðɛr wɛn aɪ wɔːkt ɪn./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So it started on day one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a gray stain by the bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə ɡreɪ steɪn baɪ ðə bɛd./
dialogue.zh: 床邊還有一塊灰灰的水漬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me write that down now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Those pipes behind the bed look wet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðoʊz paɪps bɪˈhaɪnd ðə bɛd lʊk wɛt./
dialogue.zh: 床後面那些管子看起來濕濕的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A leak can cause that smell.
dialogue.zh: 漏水確實會造成這種味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the window will not close.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is your room cold then?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold air comes in all night.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That explains your sore throat.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My throat hurts when I speak.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold on, I will send up some water.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ɑːn aɪ wɪl sɛnd ʌp sʌm ˈwɔtər./
dialogue.zh: 稍等，我叫人送些水上來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The TV has no picture either.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Does the power light come on?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, but the screen stays black.
dialogue.zh: 亮是亮著，螢幕卻一片黑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I understand so far.
dialogue.zh: 好，目前的情況我了解了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry to bring you bad news.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉帶來這麼多壞消息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please do not worry about it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bed sheets feel dirty too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That should never happen, truly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I checked it when I arrived.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did you see the dirt then?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, it looked clean at first.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，一開始看著挺乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Strange, maybe it got worse later.
dialogue.zh: 奇怪，也許是後來才變糟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A dark mark appeared on my pillow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə dɑːrk mɑːrk əˈpɪərd ɑːn maɪ ˈpɪloʊ./
dialogue.zh: 枕頭上出現一塊深色的痕跡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A mark on fresh sheets?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, right where my head rests.
dialogue.zh: 對，就在我頭靠著的位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am so embarrassed by that.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Honestly, I feel a bit upset.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I understand, you came here to rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˌʌndərˈstænd ju keɪm hɪr tə rɛst./
dialogue.zh: 我懂，您來這裡就是為了休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have a big meeting tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So sleep really matters tonight.
dialogue.zh: 所以今晚睡好非常關鍵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I just need a quiet place.
dialogue.zh: 我只需要一個安靜的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can try to fix things.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can a repair man come tonight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He works only in daytime.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then repairs will take too long.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a full fix needs hours.
dialogue.zh: 是啊，整修要好幾個小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I cannot wait that long, sorry.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I agree, waiting is not good.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there any way around this?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is one easy option.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What option? Please tell me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You could move to another room.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? Can I change rooms tonight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, if we have a free one.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪf wi hæv ə fri wʌn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have any quiet rooms?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some rooms face the back garden.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A garden room sounds really nice.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Those are our calmest rooms.
dialogue.zh: 那是我們最安靜的房型。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No loud machines next to them?
dialogue.zh: 旁邊沒有吵雜的機器嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Correct, that side is peaceful.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And no street noise at all?
dialogue.zh: 也完全聽不到街上的聲音？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not a sound from the street.
dialogue.zh: 街上的聲音一點也沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I would love a room like that.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd lʌv ə rum laɪk ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 我好想要那樣的一間房。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me search our empty rooms.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long will the search take?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just one minute, I am looking.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No problem, I am free today.
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，我今天沒有行程。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks for being so patient.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The system loads a bit slowly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No rush at all, take it easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ rʌʃ æt ɔːl teɪk ɪt ˈizi./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Found it, two rooms are free.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great news! Where are they?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Room seven ten and room eight fifteen.
dialogue.phonetic: /rum ˈsɛvən tɛn ænd rum eɪt fɪfˈtin./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which floor is room 710 on?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ flɔːr ɪz rum ˈsɛvən oʊ tuː ɑːn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seventh floor, 815 is on eighth.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvənθ flɔːr eɪt wʊn faɪv ɑːn eɪtθ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is 710 a big room?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ˈsɛvən oʊ tuː ə bɪɡ rum?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It has a king bed and a desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt hæz ə kɪŋ bɛd ænd ə dɛsk./
dialogue.zh: 裡面有加大床，還有書桌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A desk helps my work tonight.
dialogue.zh: 有書桌正適合我今晚工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: 815 is smaller but has a sofa.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt wʊn faɪv ɪz ˈsmɔːlər bʌt hæz ə ˈsoʊfə./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, I like the sound of 710.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm aɪ laɪk ðə saʊnd ʌv ˈsɛvən oʊ tuː./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good pick, 710 is very popular.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd pɪk ˈsɛvən oʊ tuː ɪz ˈvɛri ˈpɑːpjəlɚ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is anyone staying there tonight?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, it has been empty all week.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɪt hæz bɪn ˈɛmti ɔl wiːk./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, can I move tonight?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First, let me truly apologize.
dialogue.zh: 首先，請接受我真誠的道歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, I feel better already.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，我心情已經好多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This is not the stay we promise.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ɪz nɑːt ðə steɪ wi ˈprɑmɪs./
dialogue.zh: 這不是我們承諾的住宿品質。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mistakes happen, it is okay.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We will make it right tonight.
dialogue.zh: 今晚我們會把一切處理好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is good to hear.
dialogue.zh: 聽您這麼說我就放心了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, about the room price.
dialogue.zh: 再來是房間費用的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is 710 more expensive?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It usually costs twenty dollars more.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So it is a paid upgrade?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But we will not charge you.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Really? No extra cost at all?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our mistake means our bill.
dialogue.zh: 我們的疏失，費用該我們出。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is very fair of you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your price stays the same tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So I pay nothing new?
dialogue.zh: 所以我不用多付一分錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You already paid for room 502.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɔːlˈrɛdi peɪd fər rum faɪv oʊ tuː./
dialogue.zh: 您已經付過 502 的房錢了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the new room is free?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, and two floors higher too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A free upgrade, what a surprise.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Some upgrades do cost money.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But not this one, luckily.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me update your booking record.
dialogue.zh: 讓我更新您的訂房紀錄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you need my passport?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just your name and new room.
dialogue.zh: 只要您的姓名和新房號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My name is already on it?
dialogue.zh: 單子上已經有我的名字了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will print a small slip.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What does the slip show?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your room number and stay dates.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do I keep the old slip?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, we cancel that one today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, that all sounds fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You need to sign one page.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where do I sign this form?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right here on the bottom line.
dialogue.zh: 就在這裡，最下面那條線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, is everything correct?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, thanks, it looks perfect.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is my name spelled right?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, spelled right. Here is your new key.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs spɛld raɪt hɪr ɪz jɔːr nu ki./
dialogue.zh: 對，拼對了，這是您的新房卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Does the old key stop working?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, 502 will not open anymore.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs faɪv oʊ tuː wɪl nɑːt ˈoʊpən ˌɛniˈmɔːr./
dialogue.zh: 會，502 的門就打不開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And this card opens 710?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðɪs kɑːrd ˈoʊpənz ˈsɛvən oʊ tuː?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Correct, it works on the elevator.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can the elevator reach floor seven?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Of course, just tap your card.
dialogue.zh: 當然，把卡輕拍一下就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do I tap it like this?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, one tap starts the elevator.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, that seems easy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please keep the card on you.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What if I lose it?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then come back, we make a new one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn kʌm bæk wi meɪk ə nu wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 那就再下來，我們重做一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I will watch it closely.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When can I move my things?
dialogue.zh: 我什麼時候可以搬東西？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The new room is ready now.
dialogue.zh: 新房間現在就準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My bags are really heavy.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our staff can carry them up.
dialogue.zh: 我們的員工可以幫忙搬上去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is someone free to help me?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sam is on duty tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He knows the seventh floor well.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, what does Sam look like?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tall man, red shirt, big smile.
dialogue.zh: 高個子，紅襯衫，笑容很親切。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I think I saw him today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He waits right by the desk now.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi weɪts raɪt baɪ ðə dɛsk naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 他現在就在櫃台旁邊等。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should I go upstairs first?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, see the room before moving.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What if something is wrong again?
dialogue.zh: 要是新房間又有問題呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Call us and we come right up.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔːl ʌs ænd wi kʌm raɪt ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 打電話給我們，我們馬上上來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What number do I dial?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dial zero for the front desk.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Zero connects straight to you?
dialogue.zh: 撥零就直接接你們這裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, day or night we answer.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That makes me feel safe.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will check everything carefully.
dialogue.zh: 我會每一樣都仔細檢查。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, check what you need.
dialogue.zh: 聰明，需要什麼就查什麼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then Sam brings your bags up.
dialogue.zh: 接著 Sam 會把行李搬上去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, here is my old key.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks, keep your receipt with you.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: When do I get the receipt?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We will email it tonight.
dialogue.zh: 我們今晚用電子郵件寄給您。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My email is on the form.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It shows zero new charge.
dialogue.zh: 上面會顯示額外費用為零。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A zero charge is nice to see.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈzɪroʊ tʃɑːrdʒ ɪz naɪs tə siː./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am glad we solved this.
dialogue.zh: 很高興我們解決了這件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Me too, you made it easy.
dialogue.zh: 我也是，您讓一切變得很順利。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We aim to fix things fast.
dialogue.zh: 我們力求盡快解決問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You did all that so quickly.
dialogue.zh: 這一切你們處理得好快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Enjoy your quiet night in 710.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɛnˈdʒɔɪ jɔːr ˈkwaɪət naɪt ɪn ˈsɛvən oʊ tuː./
dialogue.zh: 好好享受 710 安靜的夜晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fingers crossed for real sleep.
dialogue.zh: 希望今晚能真正睡個好覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That room is cleaned every day.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hope there is no smell there.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hoʊp ðɛr ɪz noʊ smɛl ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 希望裡面沒有任何異味。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fresh sheets wait on the bed.
dialogue.zh: 乾淨的床單已鋪在床上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now I trust you fully.
dialogue.zh: 現在我完全信任你們了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not worry about anything else.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I feel much calmer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Floor seven, take the left elevator.
dialogue.zh: 去七樓請搭左邊那部電梯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The left one over there?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, it is going up right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt ɪz ˈɡoʊɪŋ ʌp raɪt naʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sam will meet me upstairs?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He follows with your two bags.
dialogue.zh: 他隨後帶著您兩件行李上去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wonderful, time to move.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, are you Sam?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that is me, hello.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You must be our 710 guest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju mʌst bi ˈaʊər ˈsɛvən oʊ tuː ɡɛst./
dialogue.zh: 您一定是 710 房的客人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I just moved from 502.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪ dʒʌst muːvd frʌm faɪv oʊ tuː./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me take those heavy bags.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, the blue one is fragile.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，藍色那件很容易碎。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is inside the blue bag?
dialogue.zh: 藍色行李箱裡裝了什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My laptop and some papers.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will carry it very gently.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I really appreciate that.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Go ahead, I have the bags.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, let us go together.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The elevator looks busy tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do we wait or use stairs?
dialogue.zh: 我們等電梯還是走樓梯？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seven floors is a lot of stairs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvən flɔːrz ɪz ə lɑːt ʌv stɛrz./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us wait a minute then.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here comes an empty elevator.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, it stops right here.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，電梯就在這層停。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: After you, step inside.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, floor seven please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pressed it, we are going up.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Elevators feel faster at night.
dialogue.zh: 晚上的電梯感覺特別快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seventh floor, what a quiet hall.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The carpet is soft up here.
dialogue.zh: 這樓層的地毯特別柔軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Room 710 is at the end.
dialogue.phonetic: /rum ˈsɛvən oʊ tuː ɪz æt ði ɛnd./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The last door on the right?
dialogue.zh: 是最右邊最後那扇門嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, here we are, room 710.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs hɪr wi ɑːr rum ˈsɛvən oʊ tuː./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me tap my card in.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The light turns green, it works.
dialogue.zh: 指示燈變綠，門開成功了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The door opens so quietly.
dialogue.zh: 門開得好輕，幾乎沒聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Welcome to your new room.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wow, this feels much bigger.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The garden view is right there.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I see trees and little lights.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Very quiet, no street noise.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I cannot hear the highway at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈkænɑt hɪr ðə ˈhaɪˌweɪ æt ɔːl./
dialogue.zh: 完全聽不到公路的聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me test the air conditioner.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The switch sits by the bed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It runs so softly here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: New units are much quieter.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And I smell fresh air.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The room was cleaned yesterday.
dialogue.zh: 房間昨天才深度清理過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The carpet feels totally dry.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No wet spots anywhere here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The window closes really easily.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the lock, turn it down.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It clicks shut, nice and warm.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No more cold nights for you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The TV works perfectly now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check one channel.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Clear picture, bright colors.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See? This room is better.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bed has tight clean sheets.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No marks that I can see.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is even a coffee machine.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cups are in that drawer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The desk lamp lights up bright.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good for your work tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bathroom looks brand new.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fresh towels are on the rail.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should I put the bags?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the rack by the window.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All done, that was quick.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you for carrying everything.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝您幫我把東西全搬上來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Need anything else from downstairs?
dialogue.zh: 還需要樓下送什麼來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not right now, I think.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The wifi code is on this card.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈwaɪfaɪ koʊd ɪz ɑːn ðɪs kɑːrd./
dialogue.zh: 網路密碼就在這張卡上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me connect my phone.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone finds the network.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Type the code in capital letters.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Connected at last, thank goodness.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our wifi is very fast here.
dialogue.zh: 我們這裡的網路向來很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This phone shows my room number.
dialogue.zh: 這台電話顯示我的房號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press zero to call the desk.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will test that later.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We answer any time of night.
dialogue.zh: 半夜什麼時候打都有人接。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the ice machine?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: End of the hall, left side.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are vending machines nearby too?
dialogue.zh: 自動販賣機也在旁邊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, right next to it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will leave you to relax.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks again, you were great.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sam, please thank the desk for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /sæm pliz θæŋk ðə dɛsk fər miː./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will tell them myself.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Have a restful night in 710.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæv ə ˈrɛstfəl naɪt ɪn ˈsɛvən oʊ tuː./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is my plan exactly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sleep tight, you earned it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good night, see you tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Front desk, good evening.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hi, it is 710 here.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ɪt ɪz ˈsɛvən oʊ tuː hɪr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How is the new room tonight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is wonderful, quiet and clean.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did everything work fine?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Even the TV and the air conditioner.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivən ði ˌtiːˈvi ænd ði ɛr kənˈdɪʃənɚ./
dialogue.zh: 電視和冷氣也都沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any smell or wet spots?
dialogue.zh: 還有異味或濕的地方嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: None at all, everything dry.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Glad we fixed it fast.
dialogue.zh: 很高興我們盡快處理好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You saved my whole trip.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sleep well, call zero anytime.
dialogue.zh: 好好睡，隨時撥零找我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, good night for real.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good morning, how was your night?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I slept nine whole hours.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No noise kept you awake?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not a single sound, finally.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The new room really helped.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It changed everything, truly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I even forgot the old room.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair enough, it was bad.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I bring you a small gift?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ brɪŋ juː ə smɔːl ɡɪft?/
dialogue.zh: 我能為您送上一份小禮嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A gift? For me today?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our manager sent this fruit plate.
dialogue.zh: 這是我們經理送的鮮果盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, apples, grapes and melon.
dialogue.zh: 哇，有蘋果、葡萄和哈密瓜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is our way of apologizing.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You really did not need to.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Enjoy it with your morning coffee.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The coffee here is lovely.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is your big meeting still today?
dialogue.zh: 您那個重要會議還是今天對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is at noon, all set.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good sleep gives a clear head.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is exactly what I need.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I ask two quick questions?
dialogue.zh: 我可以問兩個小問題嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, I am listening.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is breakfast included today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, until ten downstairs.
dialogue.zh: 有，樓下餐廳供餐到十點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The dining room is on floor one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈdaɪnɪŋ rum ɪz ɑːn flɔːr wʌn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, by the lobby entrance.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I love their fluffy pancakes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the egg bowls too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing about checkout.
dialogue.zh: 還有一件關於退房的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, what is on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could I leave a bit later?
dialogue.zh: 我可以晚一點再離開嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How late do you need?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My flight leaves late tonight.
dialogue.zh: 我的航班今晚很晚才飛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So a late checkout is smart.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two extra hours would be perfect.
dialogue.zh: 多給我兩小時就太好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Those hours are yours.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No fee for the extra time?
dialogue.zh: 多出來的時間不收費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: None, consider it our thanks.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So twelve thirty it is.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your key works until then.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can my bags stay here after that?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn maɪ bæɡz steɪ hɪr ˈæftər ðæt?/
dialogue.zh: 之後我的行李可以留在這裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We store luggage for free.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I drop my suitcase?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right here at this desk.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will pick it up at four.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl pɪk ɪt ʌp æt fɔːr./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Show the tag on your key.
dialogue.zh: 領取時請出示這個掛牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need a new tag?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No need, this tag is ready.
dialogue.zh: 不用，這張掛牌已經備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You have been so helpful.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It was our pleasure, really.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I say something about service?
dialogue.zh: 我想說說關於服務的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please do, we love feedback.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will write you a good review.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl raɪt juː ə ɡʊd ˌrivˈju./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That would mean a lot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do people leave reviews?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Scan this card, right here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five stars is what you get.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will always try to earn them.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi wɪl ˈɔlˌweɪz traɪ tə ərn ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 我們會持續努力不負好評。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I mention Sam as well?
dialogue.zh: 我可以一併提到 Sam 嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, he did a great job.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He stayed till my bags were in.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi steɪd tɪl maɪ bæɡz wɜːr ɪn./
dialogue.zh: 他陪我到行李全部定位。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sam likes to finish properly.
dialogue.zh: Sam 做事總喜歡有始有終。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will praise your quick fix.
dialogue.zh: 我要稱讚你們處理得快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Reviews help travelers choose.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My friend asked about this hotel.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What should you tell her?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell her to ask for a garden room.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl hɜːr tə æsk fər ə ˈɡɑːrdən rum./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can keep 710 just for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn kip ˈsɛvən oʊ tuː dʒʌst fər juː./
dialogue.zh: 710 我們可以特別為您留著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is 710 free next month?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ˈsɛvən oʊ tuː friː nɛkst mʌnθ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can book it today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am back here next month.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same room, same floor, for sure.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please email me the booking details.
dialogue.zh: 請用郵件把訂單細節寄給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You will get an email.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have my email still?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Saved from last night.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will a booking link arrive soon?
dialogue.zh: 預訂連結會很快寄來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one click and it is done.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wʌn klɪk ænd ɪt ɪz dʌn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for fixing my rough start.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝您補救了我糟糕的開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You made it easy for us.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I came in upset, leaving happy.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the best outcome.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The fruit plate was so sweet.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We do that for special guests.
dialogue.zh: 我們對特別客人都會這樣做。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We know your name now.
dialogue.zh: 我們現在記住您名字了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hope for good reasons.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Always good reasons, trust me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I will surely come back.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Book direct next time, online.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do direct bookings give deals?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our site has the best rates.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And free upgrades sometimes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will book on your site.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here is the website card.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tucked in my wallet already.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are all set today?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, everything is perfect now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Safe travels and sleep well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good night, see you next month!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will keep 710 warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi wɪl kip ˈsɛvən oʊ tuː wɔːrm./
